facts.business: Maral Overseas Limited is a vertically integrated textile company serving global and Indian brands with a wide range of yarns, fabrics, and apparel, with yarn as the primary revenue contributor and strategic focus on scaling fabric and garment divisions.

capacity_or_capex.item: One garment unit consolidated to optimise costs
Coal substantially replaced with biomass for energy transition

guidance_or_targets.statement: Outlook for RMG exports remains positive
Finalisation of India–EU FTA and rollover of India–UK FTA expected to provide further boost

auditor.name: S S Kothari Mehta & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No key audit matters to communicate; compliance certificate issued for Corporate Governance conditions

key_risks: High US tariffs constraining exports to the United States
Intense competitive pressures from highly fragmented industry structure
Volatility in raw material prices impacting cost structures and profitability
Uncertainty in international trade policies, tariffs, and regulatory barriers
Rising global instability and protectionist measures
facts.related_party_note: Sitting fees paid to directors: ₹26.98 lakh in FY2026 (₹24.10 lakh in FY2025); Debt defined as long and short-term borrowings excluding derivative and financial guarantee contracts per notes 18 and 19
